**Northbank Community Garden**
**Notice: North Gate Closure on Saturday 18 April**

Dear gardeners and neighbours,

The north gate will be closed on Saturday 18 April from 9 am to 2 pm while we repair a leaking water pipe. The leak has been wasting water and softening the path, so we want to fix it before the planting season begins.

During the closure, please use the east entrance. It will be open as usual, and signs will direct you from the north side. We expect the north gate to reopen by 2 pm, but please take care around the work area if repairs run late.

Because of the work, the seed swap planned for Saturday will move to Sunday at 11 am. Bring any spare seeds, seedlings or cuttings you would like to share, and feel free to come even if you have nothing to swap.

We would also welcome a few extra volunteers to help tidy the beds near the repair site afterwards. Please bring your own gloves; tools will be supplied. Mina, one of our residents, is coordinating volunteers, so please speak to her if you can help.

Thank you for your patience and support.

**Heads up, Northbank gardeners!**

The north gate's closing on Saturday 18 April from 9 am to 2 pm. That leaky water pipe by the compost bays is finally getting a proper repair, and honestly, it's about time. Anyone who's waded through the mud puddle there this month knows exactly what we mean.

While the work's underway, please come in through the east entrance. It's a slightly longer walk to the back beds, sure, but you'll pass the sweet peas, so it's hardly a hardship.

Because of the closure, we're moving the seed swap to Sunday at 11 am. Same spot, same spirit, just a day later. Bring your saved seeds, your surplus seedlings and your strong opinions about tomato varieties (we've all got them).

Fancy lending a hand? We'd love the help. Volunteers should bring their own gloves. Tools are supplied, so leave the wheelbarrow at home. Mina's coordinating volunteers this weekend, so have a word with her if you'd like to pitch in or just want to know where you're needed most.

Thanks for your patience. A garden that doesn't leak is a garden worth waiting for.

*The Northbank Community Garden*

**Northbank Community Garden**

**North gate closed: Saturday 18 April, 9 am to 2 pm**

A water pipe near the north gate is leaking, and it will be repaired on Saturday. The gate will stay shut from 9 am until 2 pm while the work is done. Please keep clear of the repair area and don't try to get past any barriers.

During those hours, use the east entrance. You can still reach the beds and paths from that side.

**Seed swap moved to Sunday**

The seed swap will now take place on Sunday at 11 am instead of Saturday. Bring the seeds you've saved, labelled if possible, and take home what you plan to grow. The time is the only change. Everything else about the swap stays the same.

**Volunteers**

If you're volunteering, bring your own gloves. Tools are supplied, so there's no need to carry spades or forks from home. Mina, one of our residents, is coordinating volunteers. Talk to her if you'd like to help or if your plans change after you've signed up.

The north gate will reopen at 2 pm once the repair is finished.

**Northbank Community Garden**
**North Gate Closed Saturday 18 April, 9 am to 2 pm**

The north gate will be shut for five hours on Saturday morning and early afternoon so that a leaking water pipe can be repaired. Everything else in the garden carries on, with two changes to the weekend's arrangements, set out below so you can find the part that affects you.

**Getting in**
Use the east entrance while the north gate is closed. The north gate reopens at 2 pm.

**Seed swap**
The seed swap moves to Sunday 19 April at 11 am. Same garden, same purpose, one day later. Tell anyone who might otherwise turn up on Saturday expecting to find it.

**Volunteering**
Volunteers are needed. Bring your own gloves. Tools are supplied, so there's no need to carry spades or forks from home. Resident Mina coordinates volunteers and can tell you where and when you're needed. Contact her at [Mina's phone number or email].

**In short**
North gate closed Saturday 18 April, 9 am to 2 pm. East entrance open. Seed swap on Sunday 19 April, 11 am. Volunteers bring gloves and speak to Mina.

Please pass this notice on to neighbours who use the garden but may not see the board.
